bio: Set within 54 acres of beautiful grounds, Norton Park is a stunning 4-star hotel located on the outskirts of Winchester.  You can enjoy a sumptuous Afternoon Tea in the warm and welcoming atmosphere of our lounge bar, followed by a stroll around the gorgeous landscaped gardens.  You will be treated to an array of delicious savouries and sweet treats all washed down with a reviving hot drink. If you're in an extra indulgent mood, why not add a glass of champagne?
